name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Lets two parties share confidential information with each other for a stated purpose while each keeps the other's information private.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Terms for a provider selling cloud software or SaaS to a customer, covering access, fees, data, warranties and liability.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Uptime and support commitments, with service credits, for a cloud service. Used alongside a Cloud Service Agreement.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: How a provider processes personal data on a customer's behalf under privacy laws such as GDPR. Used alongside a Cloud Service Agreement.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Terms for a provider performing services for a customer under statements of work, covering deliverables, fees and ownership.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Terms for licensing software that the customer installs and runs on its own systems.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: A short-term trial that lets a prospective customer evaluate a product before committing to a full commercial agreement.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Gives an early partner access to a product in development in exchange for feedback.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Terms for two companies cooperating on a business partnership, with each party's obligations set on the cover page and a license to use one party's brand.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: HIPAA terms for a provider that handles protected health information (PHI) on behalf of a healthcare customer.

name: AI Addendum
description: Terms for AI features in a product, covering inputs, outputs and model training. Used alongside a Cloud Service Agreement or Software License Agreement.
